title: 第13章 一步登天第14章 最强功法昊天战意
slug: 我只想毁灭宗门咋逆天成神了
lines: 顾明朝闭的是死关，昊天宗只要不是遇到真的没有他解决不了的事情，他是断然不会出来的。
哪怕是之前昊天宗洪钟九响，顾明朝都没有理会那么多。
但今日顾明朝出来了！
因为被昊天剑匣引动的不光大长老的灭魂剑，顾明朝的擎天剑也在其中。
能引得神剑拜服，顾明朝知道，整个昊天宗唯有那传说之中的昊天剑匣。
可亲眼通过昊天镜看到灵冢之中的一切之时，顾明朝哪怕有所准备还是被眼前的一切给惊到了。
传说之中的昊天剑匣，连昊天大帝都无法收服的昊天剑匣竟然在今日选择了认主，而这主人不是什么绝世强者，而是一个刚刚入门的弟子。
毕竟会进入灵冢的，只有刚入门的弟子才可以。
但很快顾明朝就发现了不对劲的地方。
这个得到昊天剑匣的弟子竟然身穿核心弟子特有的衣服！
所以……他是核心弟子？
可顾明朝记得这一批进入昊天宗的弟子之中，虽然有几个比较优秀的，但也不过是成为后备精英弟子而已，这一批弟子之中什么时候出现核心弟子了？
要知道，核心弟子跟精英弟子不一样，精英弟子可以由各宫的长老来直接任命，但要成为核心弟子，整个昊天宗有这个权力的也只有两人，一个是他顾明朝，而另外一个便是大长老了。
所以顾明朝将目光第一时间看向了大长老，他想要知道自己闭关的这段时间到底发生了什么。
“恭喜宗主出关……”
看到顾明朝有些发愣的眼神，大长老怎么可能不知道宗主在想什么，而此时看到昊天镜之中的楚星河之时，大长老是一脸骄傲啊。
随之大长老也开口将这段日子发生的事情一五一十的跟宗主禀报。
从洪钟九响开始，楚星河甘愿为同乡背锅，到朱雀殿朱雀灵火四百年后再现世。
再到后面朱雀炉火烧药王宫，朱雀通灵药圣传承，以及现在的灵冢内昊天剑匣认主。
听完大长老所言，顾明朝就觉得脑子嗡嗡的，自己闭关这点时间，宗门内竟然发生了这么多的事情？
出了一个如此逆天的弟子？
而且更让顾明朝难以置信的是，楚星河乃是大长老所在的灵鹤宫弟子，大长老把楚星河夸上天那是可以理解的，但是随着大长老说完，其他长老也纷纷跟着夸赞就真的让顾明朝吃惊了。
从其他长老口中，顾明朝对楚星河又有了更加深刻的了解。
天赋绝伦，身具朱雀灵火再得药圣传承，现在还拿到了昊天剑匣，可这个孩子除了天赋之外，人品秉性更是得到了众多长老的一致认可。
昊天宗从来不缺天之骄子，可是能得到几乎所有长老认可的弟子，这在昊天宗还真的是头一份啊。
一时间顾明朝对楚星河充满了兴趣，这到底是一个什么样的小家伙呢？
灵冢之中，昊天剑匣融入楚星河身体的刹那，楚星河一直以来，困在一品武者的桎梏也终于被打破，灵力瞬间暴涨，楚星河也成功踏入了二品武师境界，走到这一步才算是真正踏入修炼之路。
踏入二品的可不光楚星河一人，这会儿所有信了楚星河在这里选取了灵兵的弟子，不光灵魂跟灵兵融合，更是在顿悟之中完成突破，一举踏入二品！
“星河师兄之恩，万霖此生不忘！”
万霖这会儿激动的胸口上下起伏，对着楚星河九十度鞠躬行礼。
“星河师兄之恩，我等此生不忘！”
content_en:
Gu Mingchao's lock was a death lock, and unless the Haotian Sect encountered something that he couldn't solve, he would definitely not come out.
Even if the Haotian Sect's Hong Bell rang nine times before, Gu Mingchao didn't pay much attention to it.
But today Gu Mingchao came out!
Because not only the Great Elder's Soul-Destroying Sword was attracted by the Haotian Sword Box, but Gu Mingchao's Sky-Lifting Sword was also among them.
Gu Mingchao knew that the only thing in the entire Haotian Sect that could attract the worship of the Divine Sword was the legendary Haotian Sword Box.
But when he saw everything in the tomb through the Haotian Mirror with his own eyes, even though Gu Mingchao was prepared, he was still shocked by what he saw.
The legendary Haotian Sword Box, which even Emperor Haotian could not conquer, actually chose to recognize its owner today, and this owner is not a peerless strong man, but a disciple who has just started.
After all, only new disciples can enter the spiritual tomb.
But soon Gu Mingchao discovered something was wrong.
The disciple who got the Haotian Sword Box was actually wearing clothes unique to the core disciples!
So...he is a core disciple?
But Gu Mingchao remembered that among the disciples who entered Haotian Sect, although there were a few outstanding ones, they were just reserve elite disciples. When did the core disciples appear among this group of disciples?
You must know that core disciples are different from elite disciples. Elite disciples can be directly appointed by the elders of each palace. However, to become a core disciple, there are only two people in the entire Haotian Sect who have this power. One is Gu Mingchao, and the other is the great elder.
So Gu Mingchao immediately looked at the Great Elder. He wanted to know what happened during his retreat.
"Congratulations to the sect master for coming out of seclusion..."
Seeing the dazed look in Gu Mingchao's eyes, how could the elder not know what the sect leader was thinking? But when he saw Chu Xinghe in the Haotian Mirror, the elder looked proud.
Then the great elder also opened his mouth to report everything that happened during this period to the sect master.
Starting from the ninth ring of the Hong Bell, Chu Xinghe was willing to take the blame for his fellow villagers, and then reappeared four hundred years later in the Suzaku Hall.
Later, the Suzaku Furnace Burns Medicine Palace, the inheritance of the Suzaku Spiritual Medicine Saint, and the current Haotian Sword Box in the spiritual tomb recognizes its owner.
After listening to what the great elder said, Gu Mingchao felt his head buzzing. During the short time he spent in seclusion, so many things happened in the sect?
A disciple who was so defiant was born?
What makes Gu Mingchao even more unbelievable is that Chu Xinghe is a disciple of the Linghe Palace where the great elder is located. It is understandable that the great elder praises Chu Xinghe to the sky, but after the great elder finished speaking, other elders also followed suit and praised him, which really surprised Gu Mingchao.
From the mouths of other elders, Gu Mingchao gained a deeper understanding of Chu Xinghe.
He is extremely talented, possesses the Vermillion Bird Spiritual Fire, has been inherited by the Medicine Saint, and now has the Haotian Sword Box. However, in addition to his talent, this child's character and character have been unanimously recognized by many elders.
The Haotian Sect has never been short of talented disciples, but it is really the first time for a disciple to be recognized by almost all the elders in the Haotian Sect.
For a moment, Gu Mingchao was full of interest in Chu Xinghe. What kind of little guy was he?
In the spiritual tomb, the moment the Haotian Sword Box merged into Chu Xinghe's body, the shackles that Chu Xinghe had been trapped in as a first-grade warrior were finally broken. His spiritual power surged instantly, and Chu Xinghe also successfully entered the realm of a second-grade martial artist. Only when he reached this point could he truly enter the path of cultivation.
Chu Xinghe is not the only one who has entered the second level. At this moment, all the disciples who believe that Chu Xinghe has chosen the spiritual weapon here not only merge their souls with the spiritual weapon, but also complete a breakthrough in their enlightenment and step into the second level in one fell swoop!
"Senior Brother Xinghe's kindness will never be forgotten by Wan Lin in this life!"
Wan Lin's chest was rising and falling with excitement at this moment, and he bowed ninety degrees to Chu Xinghe.
"Senior Brother Xinghe's kindness will be something I will never forget in this lifetime!"
